tools.name: pulse_lanes
tools.description: List agent-work lanes with verdict, freshness, and confidence. Optional filters narrow the list; omit them all to get every lane.

tools.name: pulse_lane_detail
tools.description: Full lane record: verdict rationale, adapter, attempts, settlements, linked evidence.

tools.name: pulse_should_i_bid
tools.description: Evidence-backed recommendation on whether an autonomous agent should spend attempts on a lane.

tools.name: pulse_evidence
tools.description: Read the hash-chained evidence ledger: one record by id, every record for a lane, or the whole chain.

tools.name: pulse_stats
tools.description: Index-wide counts: lanes, probes, evidence records, attempts, settlements, and the snapshot date they describe.

tools.name: pulse_methodology
tools.description: The grading rules themselves: what each grade requires, how freshness is derived, and how Unknown is handled.

tools.name: pulse_resources
tools.description: Query the agent directory: models, MCP servers, frameworks, tools, platforms, work lanes and more.

tools.name: pulse_jobs
tools.description: Live job listings collected from the agent-accessible lanes — reward, currency, bid count and posting age per listing. Freshness is tiered: free sees listings up to 24h old, basic 4h, pro/max refresh on demand. Keyed calls count against the daily pull quota.

tools.name: pulse_resource_detail
tools.description: Full directory record for one resource: metadata, capabilities, links and source.
